column1: NMDR for Federal Housing Administration, All Loans

The National Mortgage Default Rate (NMDR) measures how the loans originated in a given month would perform if subjected to the same stress as in the financial crisis that began in 2007. It measures the default risk of newly originated mortgages by assigning every loan a predicted default rate based on its credit score, CLTV, DTI, Loan Term, ARM status, Agency, Loan Purpose, and Occupancy Type.
